# systeam_notification_channel (Data Source)

Look up an existing notification channel by name within an organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the notification channel to look up.
- `organization_id` (Number) The organization the notification channel belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `channel_type` (String) The notification channel type.
- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the notification channel.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the notification channel is active.
